codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes, Ordinance Requirements
findings.comment: The required note stating 'All improvements shall be made in accordance with the released site plan. Any additional improvements will require a site plan amendment and approval from the Development Services Department.' is not present on the cover sheet. While similar language appears on other plan sheets, the cover sheet is the required location for this mandatory compliance statement.

Project includes 39 townhome units in 8 buildings with individual unit sites. Cover sheet lacks required note stating 'Each lot/footprint/unit site represents the maximum potential development. Actual development may be the same or less than what is shown.' This note is mandatory when multiple development footprints with individual envelopes are shown.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and throughout plan set
findings.comment: Cover sheet does not include a notation conventions section, legend, or specification of drawing standards (line weights, symbols, line types) to be applied throughout the construction documents. A notation conventions key or reference to standard conventions must be established on the cover sheet.

applicableAreas: Landscape sheets, tree plan sheets, and other supplementary sheets
findings.comment: Case number SP-2025-0126C is not displayed on all sheets of the plan set. Verification shows the case number present on cover sheet (Sheet 1), grading plan (Sheet 11), and biofiltration plan (Sheet 15), but missing from landscape sheets (Sheets 30, 31) and other supplementary sheets. Case number must appear on every sheet including all landscape, tree, and detail sheets.

Cover sheet does not include a formal Related Cases section as required by UCM 2.5.1(E). Related case information is scattered in the Site Development Data table rather than presented in a dedicated, clearly labeled Related Cases section. A formal Related Cases section must be added per code requirements.

applicableAreas: Related Cases section (not present on cover sheet)
findings.comment: Related Cases section is missing from cover sheet. Although zoning case number (C14-2011-0093) appears in the Site Development Data table, it must appear in a formal Related Cases section per UCM 2.5.1(E). All applicable zoning case numbers and ordinance references must be properly listed in the Related Cases section.

applicableAreas: Related Cases section (not present on cover sheet)
findings.comment: Related Cases section is missing from cover sheet. Subdivision file number (C8S-75-160) appears in Site Development Data table, but without a formal Related Cases section, subdivision cases and Austin Water subdivision file numbers are not properly documented per UCM 2.5.1.E.6.

applicableAreas: Related Cases section (not present on cover sheet)
findings.comment: Prior site plan approval SP-97-0145CS (Southwood Nursing Care Center Addition, approved 1997) is not noted on cover sheet. Prior site plan case numbers must be documented in the Related Cases section. This prior approval is material to the property development history.

applicableAreas: Related Cases section (not present on cover sheet)
findings.comment: Commercial Tree Permit case number is not documented on cover sheet. An active Commercial Tree Permit is pending (filed 2025-08-14 per project records). Tree Permit case numbers must be listed in the Related Cases section per reviewer convention.

FAR (Floor Area Ratio) applicability for MF-2 zoning cannot be confirmed from available documents. If MF-2 zoning requires FAR limits, the calculations are not shown on the cover sheet. Clarification on whether MF-2 is subject to FAR limits and, if so, whether calculations must be provided is needed.

Redevelopment exception election cannot be confirmed from available documents. Existing impervious cover is at the 65% cap (Urban watershed), and proposed IC is approximately 59.5-60%. While this pattern suggests potential redevelopment exception use, no explicit election statement or applicable LDC section citation (§ 25-8-25 for Urban watersheds) appears on the cover sheet or in accessible engineering report sections. Confirmation of whether exception is being elected is required.

The Engineer's Summary Letter exists in the project submittal, but the detailed body content containing case number verification is not accessible from the available document extracts. The engineer's report must be reviewed in full to confirm case number SP-2025-0126C is properly cited throughout.
